controls.description: Workflow approval and segregation-of-duties validation for access changes for Ensure system access is provisioned only to authorized personnel
controls.what: Confirms requester approval, role appropriateness, and segregation-of-duties compliance before access is provisioned or modified. The activity is tailored to the risk that terminated or transferred employees retain active system access.
controls.when: Before each access change is fulfilled

controls.why: Prevents unauthorized or excessive access from being granted. Specifically addresses the risk that terminated or transferred employees retain active system access.
controls.evidence: Approved access tickets, workflow history, and segregation-of-duties exception logs

controls.description: Periodic recertification of active and privileged access for Ensure system access is provisioned only to authorized personnel

controls.when: Within ten business days of quarter-end
controls.where: IAM reporting and HR termination roster
controls.how: Compares system-generated access listings to HR records and remediation tickets. It focuses on the context of User Access Management.
controls.why: Detects unauthorized or stale access that bypassed the provisioning workflow. Specifically addresses the risk that terminated or transferred employees retain active system access.
controls.evidence: Quarterly access review package, reviewer sign-off, and remediation tickets
